passages.title: 사회 규범과 개인의 선택
passages.body:
In many societies, individual choices are shaped by social norms that people often accept without conscious reflection. These norms, which are passed down through schools, families, and the media, influence what individuals consider acceptable or desirable.

As a result, people may make decisions that appear personal but are deeply connected to the expectations of the groups to which they belong. This tendency becomes especially visible in situations where conformity is rewarded while deviation is subtly discouraged.

Individuals who might challenge prevailing norms may face social pressure that discourages open expression of alternative views. Such pressure, which is rarely imposed through formal rules, operates through everyday interactions that signal approval or disapproval.

Understanding the social mechanisms that guide individual behavior allows people to recognize the limits of autonomy and to question assumptions that have long been taken for granted.

words.example: Social norms shape what we consider desirable.
She decided on reflection to accept his offer after all.   그녀는 심사숙고한 끝에 결국 그의 제의를 받아들이기로 결심했다.

grammars.title: 현재완료의 계속적 용법 (have p.p.)
grammars.note: 주절 동사가 현재(allows)이므로, 과거부터 지금까지 이어지는 상태는 현재완료로 씁니다. 과거완료(had p.p.)는 기준이 되는 과거 시점이 문장에 있어야 성립합니다.
grammars.example: assumptions that have long been taken for granted

grammars.title: 계속적 용법의 관계대명사 (, which)
grammars.note: 콤마 + which는 앞의 명사를 부연 설명합니다. that으로 바꿔 쓸 수 없습니다.
grammars.example: These norms, which are passed down through schools, ...

grammars.title: 전치사 + 관계대명사
grammars.note: to which they belong = which they belong to. 격식 있는 문어체에서 전치사를 앞으로 보냅니다.
grammars.example: the groups to which they belong
